game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Sand Dunes – Mirage Road, a road of shimmering mirages: the scarab scholar must handle desert bandits while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Code Reading Relay: Read short programs as a relay and predict their output line by line.
theme: Sand Dunes – Mirage Road: a road of shimmering mirages
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Print every even number from 20 through 38. Trace the update by 2 and the final failed condition. Test dataset 5: {}; {}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Code Reading Relay' (Week 9 slot 10), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Mirage Road'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Chain 9 consecutive correct decisions about predicted to power up the scarab scholar and open the caravan wagon.
source_lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
source_game_title: Code Reading Relay – Mirage Road Streak
hint: Coordinates begin at the top left. Walls block movement. Use int declarations, observe(value), movement calls, and { } for local scope.
